Why have media companies owned by Mukesh Ambani and Gautam Adani joined a Supreme Court challenge against the Modi government's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act?
On October 27, 2026, the Supreme Court issued a notice to the Central Government after the Digital News Publishers Association (DNPA), representing 21 major news publishers including Network18, NDTV, The Indian Express, India Today and The Hindu, challenged provisions of India's new privacy law.
